# Audit Log

The audit process checks every record before it moves to the archive. The audit process logs each check so reviewers can trace it later.

The audit process checks every invoice before it moves to the ledger. The audit process logs each entry so auditors can trace it later.

The audit process checks every shipment before it moves to the warehouse. The audit process logs each shipment so managers can trace it later.
